# Raw-native upstream training oracles

These three compressed JSON fixtures are generated by pinned upstream DeepH,
DeepH-E3 and MACE-H graph builders and models. Raw s/p native records include
nonzero periodic images. Expectations contain preprocessing, exact initialized
parameters, decoded predictions, full gradients and three fresh Adam updates.
No MANDALA forward generates the expected numbers.

`tests/workflow/test_scientific_training_contracts.py` reconstructs the native
files and replays them through the public MANDALA loader. DeepH covers computed
and stored frames. Each fixture records source commit/hashes, runtime versions,
precision, seeds and optimizer settings. DeepH initializes in float32 and then
uses float64 preprocessing/evaluation; the others use float64 throughout.

Regenerate with the pinned checkouts in the recorded environment:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src:. python scripts/generate_raw_training_fixtures.py \
  --deeph-root /path/to/DeepH-pack \
  --deeph-e3-root /path/to/DeepH-E3 \
  --mace-h-root /path/to/MACE-H
```

Replay needs neither those checkouts nor external data. MACE-H uses identity
calibration for this model-math oracle; separate real-data tests verify
training-only statistics and supervision isolation. These short traces do not
certify every historical training-controller detail or publication accuracy.
The older supplied-feature oracles remain under `../reference_operators/`.

The `configuration.pipeline` sections were re-resolved from the current
recipes after the reference layers were decomposed into library blocks; the
upstream expectations are unchanged.
